knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unidentified product is quarantined and reported. It is never tested or used on guesswork.
Mixing can create hazardous reactions and unpredictable results.
Chemicals are kept apart from food and food-contact items.

practicalCriteria: Confirms label, dilution, contact time and rinsing for a product in a mock kitchen before use.
Quarantines a simulated unlabelled product and reports it.
Demonstrates separate storage of chemicals from food items.
passRule: Product verified from label and SDS, unidentified product quarantined, and storage separated from food, observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Report of the simulated unlabelled product
stopWorkCriteria: Unidentified product in a food area
Chemical transferred into a food container
